description: This file implements the ListView page for a CRM module in vtiger CRM, handling display of records, sorting, filtering, permissions, and navigation.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Represents and manages custom views for modules, including view permissions and HTML rendering.

classes.name: QueryGenerator
classes.description: Builds and manages database queries for listing records based on current filters and views.

classes.name: ListViewController
classes.description: Controls list view operations, including generating headers and entries for the list display.

methods.name: initSortbyField
methods.description: Initializes the default sort field for the listing.

methods.name: getOrderBy
methods.description: Returns the current field by which records are ordered.

methods.name: getViewId
methods.description: Retrieves the view ID for the current custom view.

methods.name: getCustomViewCombo
methods.description: Generates HTML for custom view selection.

methods.name: getCustomViewByCvid
methods.description: Fetches details of a custom view by its ID.

methods.name: isPermittedChangeStatus
methods.description: Checks if the status of a custom view can be changed.

methods.name: isPermittedCustomView
methods.description: Checks user's permission for specific custom view actions.

methods.name: getQuery
methods.description: Constructs and returns the SQL query to list records.

methods.name: getConditionalWhere
methods.description: Returns conditional WHERE clause for the query based on filters.

methods.name: getListViewHeader
methods.description: Generates headers for the list view.

methods.name: getListViewEntries
methods.description: Fetches the list entries/records for display.

methods.name: getBasicSearchFieldInfoList
methods.description: Retrieves basic search options for the list view.
